Every Access Provider and International Long Distance Operators shall ensure that no international incoming SMS containing alphanumeric header or originating country code +91 is delivered through its network. Provided that Authority may issue directions as it deems necessary to control bulk international messages from time to time. 38. Repeal and Saving. - Save as provided hereunder, The Telecom Commercial Communications Customer Preference Regulations, 2010 (6 of 2010) are hereby repealed.
